    LongRangeSensors¶

    LongRangeSensors — Search + Save (UIEG) and Run Search.

    Modules live in this package. Imports are lazy so import LongRangeSensors stays cheap until a module is actually touched.

    _LAZY = {'app': 'LongRangeSensors.app', 'external_search_panel': 'LongRangeSensors.external_search_panel', 'web_search_clients': 'LongRangeSensors.web_search_clients', 'uieg_capture_panel': 'LongRangeSensors.uieg_capture_panel', 'uieg_crawler': 'LongRangeSensors.uieg_crawler', 'uieg_database': 'LongRangeSensors.uieg_database', 'uieg_import': 'LongRangeSensors.uieg_import', 'uieg_paths': 'LongRangeSensors.uieg_paths', 'uieg_preview': 'LongRangeSensors.uieg_preview', 'uieg_promote': 'LongRangeSensors.uieg_promote', 'uieg_repo_fetch': 'LongRangeSensors.uieg_repo_fetch'} module-attribute ¶

    def __getattr__(name: str):
    import importlib

    if name in _LAZY:
        return importlib.import_module(_LAZY[name])
    raise AttributeError(f"module {__name__!r} has no attribute {name!r}")

    class ExternalSearchPanel(QWidget):
    """Central panel: API search results + Capture URL / Clone repo."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        theme: dict,
        *,
        source: str,
        query: str,
        limit: int = 10,
        uieg_cfg: Optional[dict] = None,
        search_cfg: Optional[dict] = None,
        parent=None,
    ):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.theme = theme or {}
        self.source = source
        self.query = query
        self.limit = int(limit or 10)
        self.cfg = merge_uieg_config(uieg_cfg)
        self.search_cfg = search_cfg or {}
        self._results: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
        self._worker: Optional[QThread] = None

        ensure_capture_folder(self.cfg["capture_folder"])
        self._build_ui()
        self.apply_theme()
        self._start_search()

    def _build_ui(self):
        root = QVBoxLayout(self)
        title = QLabel("External Search — GitHub / Brave")
        title.setFont(QFont("Segoe UI", 14, QFont.Weight.Bold))
        root.addWidget(title)

        self.meta_lbl = QLabel(
            f"Source: {self.source}  ·  Query: {self.query}  ·  Limit: {self.limit}"
        )
        self.meta_lbl.setWordWrap(True)
        root.addWidget(self.meta_lbl)

        hint = QLabel(
            "Research stays on disk until you Import (Search + Save). "
            "Promote to Ship's Computer is a separate Browse action — Ask AI will not "
            "see these until you Promote."
        )
        hint.setWordWrap(True)
        root.addWidget(hint)

        self.status_lbl = QLabel("Searching…")
        root.addWidget(self.status_lbl)

        bar = QHBoxLayout()
        self.open_btn = QPushButton("Open")
        self.open_btn.clicked.connect(self._on_open)
        bar.addWidget(self.open_btn)
        self.capture_btn = QPushButton("Capture URL")
        self.capture_btn.clicked.connect(self._on_capture)
        bar.addWidget(self.capture_btn)
        self.clone_btn = QPushButton("Clone / Zip repo")
        self.clone_btn.clicked.connect(self._on_clone)
        bar.addWidget(self.clone_btn)
        self.retry_btn = QPushButton("Retry search")
        self.retry_btn.clicked.connect(self._start_search)
        bar.addWidget(self.retry_btn)
        bar.addStretch()
        root.addLayout(bar)

        self.table = QTableWidget(0, 4)
        self.table.setHorizontalHeaderLabels(["Title", "URL", "Snippet", "Meta"])
        self.table.setSelectionBehavior(QTableWidget.SelectionBehavior.SelectRows)
        self.table.setSelectionMode(QTableWidget.SelectionMode.SingleSelection)
        self.table.setEditTriggers(QTableWidget.EditTrigger.NoEditTriggers)
        self.table.horizontalHeader().setSectionResizeMode(0, QHeaderView.ResizeMode.ResizeToContents)
        self.table.horizontalHeader().setSectionResizeMode(1, QHeaderView.ResizeMode.Stretch)
        self.table.horizontalHeader().setSectionResizeMode(2, QHeaderView.ResizeMode.Stretch)
        self.table.horizontalHeader().setSectionResizeMode(3, QHeaderView.ResizeMode.ResizeToContents)
        self.table.doubleClicked.connect(lambda *_: self._on_open())
        root.addWidget(self.table, stretch=1)

        self.log = QTextEdit()
        self.log.setReadOnly(True)
        self.log.setMaximumHeight(110)
        self.log.setFont(QFont("Consolas", 9))
        root.addWidget(self.log)

    def apply_theme(self):
        self.setStyleSheet(_panel_stylesheet(self.theme))

    def _append_log(self, text: str):
        self.log.append(text.rstrip())

    def _set_busy(self, busy: bool):
        for b in (
            self.open_btn,
            self.capture_btn,
            self.clone_btn,
            self.retry_btn,
        ):
            b.setEnabled(not busy)

    def _selected_item(self) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:
        rows = self.table.selectionModel().selectedRows() if self.table.selectionModel() else []
        if not rows:
            return None
        idx = rows[0].row()
        if idx < 0 or idx >= len(self._results):
            return None
        return self._results[idx]

    def _start_search(self):
        if self._worker and self._worker.isRunning():
            return
        self._set_busy(True)
        self.status_lbl.setText("Searching…")
        self.table.setRowCount(0)
        self._results = []
        w = _SearchWorker(
            self.source, self.query, self.limit, self.search_cfg, parent=self
        )
        w.finished_ok.connect(self._on_search_ok)
        w.finished_err.connect(self._on_search_err)
        w.finished.connect(lambda: self._set_busy(False))
        self._worker = w
        w.start()

    def _on_search_ok(self, items: list, note: str):
        self._results = list(items or [])
        self.table.setRowCount(0)
        for item in self._results:
            r = self.table.rowCount()
            self.table.insertRow(r)
            vals = [
                str(item.get("title", "")),
                str(item.get("url", "")),
                str(item.get("snippet", ""))[:300],
                str(item.get("meta", "")),
            ]
            for c, v in enumerate(vals):
                self.table.setItem(r, c, QTableWidgetItem(v))
        self.status_lbl.setText(note or f"{len(self._results)} result(s)")
        self._append_log(note or "Search complete.")

    def _on_search_err(self, err: str):
        self.status_lbl.setText(err)
        self._append_log(err)
        QMessageBox.warning(self, "External Search", err)

    def _on_open(self):
        item = self._selected_item()
        if not item or not item.get("url"):
            QMessageBox.information(self, "Open", "Select a result row first.")
            return
        QDesktopServices.openUrl(QUrl(item["url"]))

    def _on_capture(self):
        item = self._selected_item()
        if not item or not item.get("url"):
            QMessageBox.information(self, "Capture URL", "Select a result row first.")
            return
        url = item["url"]
        capture_folder = default_crawl_folder(self.cfg["capture_folder"])
        link_limit = int(self.cfg.get("crawl_link_limit", 10))
        timeout = int(self.cfg.get("crawl_timeout_sec", 15))

        def work(log):
            return crawl_url_to_disk(
                url,
                capture_folder,
                link_limit=link_limit,
                timeout_sec=timeout,
                fetch_code_links=True,
                log=log,
            )

        self._run_action(
            work,
            on_ok=lambda paths: self._append_log(
                f"Capture wrote {len(paths or [])} file(s) under {capture_folder}. "
                "Use UIEG nav 2 Crawl — Website / Import to load uieg_capture.db."
            ),
        )

    def _on_clone(self):
        item = self._selected_item()
        if not item:
            QMessageBox.information(self, "Clone / Zip", "Select a result row first.")
            return
        url = item.get("url") or ""
        if item.get("kind") != "github_repo" and not parse_github_repo(url):
            QMessageBox.information(
                self,
                "Clone / Zip",
                "Clone / Zip is for GitHub repository results.\n"
                "Use Capture URL for web pages.",
            )
            return
        capture_folder = default_repo_folder(self.cfg["capture_folder"])
        exts = set(self.cfg.get("repo_extensions") or [])

        def work(log):
            return fetch_repo_to_capture(
                url,
                capture_folder,
                extensions=exts or None,
                log=log,
            )

        self._run_action(
            work,
            on_ok=lambda paths: self._append_log(
                f"Repo fetch wrote {len(paths or [])} file(s). "
                "Use UIEG nav 1 Repo / GitHub Fetch → Then Import to load the DB."
            ),
        )

    def _run_action(self, fn: Callable, on_ok: Optional[Callable] = None):
        if self._worker and self._worker.isRunning():
            return
        self._set_busy(True)
        w = _ActionWorker(fn, parent=self)
        w.log_line.connect(self._append_log)
        if on_ok:
            w.finished_ok.connect(on_ok)
        w.finished_err.connect(
            lambda e: (
                self._append_log(f"Error: {e}"),
                QMessageBox.warning(self, "Action failed", e),
            )
        )
        w.finished.connect(lambda: self._set_busy(False))
        self._worker = w
        w.start()

    class UiegCapturePanel(QWidget):
    """Channel-scoped capture workspace (repo fetch or website crawl)."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        theme: dict,
        uieg_cfg: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
        mode: Literal["repo", "crawl"] = "crawl",
        source_hint: str = "1) GitHub",
        query_hint: str = "",
        parent=None,
    ):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.theme = theme
        self.mode = mode
        self.channel = CHANNEL_REPO if mode == "repo" else CHANNEL_CRAWL
        self.cfg = merge_uieg_config(uieg_cfg)
        self._worker: Optional[_Worker] = None
        self._preview_server = None
        self._preview_port = None
        self._temp_dir = os.path.join(self.cfg["capture_folder"], "_preview_tmp")
        self.channel_folder = (
            default_repo_folder(self.cfg["capture_folder"])
            if mode == "repo"
            else default_crawl_folder(self.cfg["capture_folder"])
        )

        ensure_capture_folder(self.cfg["capture_folder"])
        migrated, msg = migrate_legacy_db(self.cfg["database_path"])
        init_db(self.cfg["database_path"])

        root = QVBoxLayout(self)
        if mode == "repo":
            title = QLabel("1 Repo / GitHub Fetch")
            hint = QLabel(
                f"Source: GitHub owner/repo or URL. "
                f"Destination: {self.channel_folder}/<owner>_<repo>/ "
                f"(temp clones under _repos/). "
                f"Fetch → Then Import to DB → Browse / Preview. "
                f"Prefer this path for .md / .py source truth. "
                f"DB: {self.cfg['database_path']}"
            )
        else:
            title = QLabel("2 Crawl — Website / Import")
            hint = QLabel(
                f"Source: website URL (requests + BeautifulSoup, not full browser JS). "
                f"Destination: {self.channel_folder}/ (flat crawl files). "
                f"Crawl → Import → Browse / Preview. "
                f"For GitHub code, use nav step 1 Repo / GitHub Fetch instead. "
                f"DB: {self.cfg['database_path']}"
            )
        title.setFont(QFont("Segoe UI", 14, QFont.Weight.Bold))
        root.addWidget(title)
        hint.setWordWrap(True)
        root.addWidget(hint)

        bar = QHBoxLayout()
        self.refresh_btn = _action_btn("Refresh DB", "#5C6BC0")
        self.refresh_btn.clicked.connect(self.refresh_db_view)
        bar.addWidget(self.refresh_btn)
        self.promote_btn = _action_btn("Promote to Ship's Computer", "#2E7D32")
        self.promote_btn.setToolTip(
            "Copy selected research captures into promoted_research/ and ingest "
            "into ship_computer.db (Ask AI). Research-only captures stay in uieg until you Promote."
        )
        self.promote_btn.clicked.connect(self._promote_selected)
        bar.addWidget(self.promote_btn)
        self.open_folder_btn = _action_btn("Open channel folder", "#78909C")
        self.open_folder_btn.setToolTip(f"Open {self.channel_folder}")
        self.open_folder_btn.clicked.connect(self._open_capture_folder)
        bar.addWidget(self.open_folder_btn)
        self.clear_btn = _action_btn("Clear Data", "#C44A4A")
        self.clear_btn.clicked.connect(self._clear_data)
        bar.addWidget(self.clear_btn)
        bar.addStretch()
        self.status_lbl = QLabel("")
        bar.addWidget(self.status_lbl)
        root.addLayout(bar)

        self.tabs = QTabWidget()
        self._preview_tab_index = 0
        if mode == "repo":
            self.tabs.addTab(self._build_repo_tab(source_hint, query_hint), "Repo")
            self.tabs.addTab(self._build_browse_tab(), "Browse")
            self.tabs.addTab(self._build_preview_tab(), "Preview")
            self._preview_tab_index = 2
        else:
            self.tabs.addTab(self._build_open_url_tab(source_hint, query_hint), "Crawl")
            self.tabs.addTab(self._build_import_tab(), "Import")
            self.tabs.addTab(self._build_browse_tab(), "Browse")
            self.tabs.addTab(self._build_preview_tab(), "Preview")
            self._preview_tab_index = 3
        root.addWidget(self.tabs, stretch=1)

        self.log = QTextEdit()
        self.log.setReadOnly(True)
        self.log.setMaximumHeight(120)
        self.log.setFont(QFont("Consolas", 9))
        root.addWidget(self.log)

        self.apply_theme()
        if migrated:
            self._append_log(msg)
        self.refresh_db_view()

    # ── Tabs ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    def _build_browse_tab(self) -> QWidget:
        w = QWidget()
        lay = QVBoxLayout(w)
        tip = QLabel(
            f"Research memory ({self.channel} channel in uieg_capture.db). "
            "Select rows → Promote to Ship's Computer when you want Ask AI / Deep Dive to see them. "
            "Click column headers to sort. "
            "Tiny text files (< 64 B) skip Preview on click (time saver)."
        )
        tip.setWordWrap(True)
        lay.addWidget(tip)

        # Find (any column) — same idea as Documents Search
        find_row = QHBoxLayout()
        find_row.addWidget(QLabel("Find:"))
        self.browse_find_input = QLineEdit()
        self.browse_find_input.setPlaceholderText(
            "Search filename, path, type, source, size, promoted…"
        )
        self.browse_find_input.returnPressed.connect(self._on_browse_find)
        find_row.addWidget(self.browse_find_input, stretch=1)
        find_btn = _action_btn("Find", "#1565C0")
        find_btn.clicked.connect(self._on_browse_find)
        find_row.addWidget(find_btn)
        lay.addLayout(find_row)

        # Filter — path/name + type (Documents Path/Ext style)
        filter_row = QHBoxLayout()
        filter_row.addWidget(QLabel("Path:"))
        self.browse_filter_input = QLineEdit()
        self.browse_filter_input.setPlaceholderText(
            "Path or filename contains (e.g. github, README, .py)"
        )
        filter_row.addWidget(self.browse_filter_input, stretch=1)
        filter_row.addWidget(QLabel("Type:"))
        self.browse_type_combo = QComboBox()
        self.browse_type_combo.setEditable(True)
        self.browse_type_combo.addItems(
            ["*", "html", "htm", "md", "py", "txt", "json", "png", "jpg"]
        )
        self.browse_type_combo.setCurrentText("*")
        self.browse_type_combo.setMinimumWidth(80)
        filter_row.addWidget(self.browse_type_combo)
        apply_btn = _action_btn("Apply Filter", "#2E7D32")
        apply_btn.clicked.connect(self._on_browse_apply_filter)
        filter_row.addWidget(apply_btn)
        clear_btn = _action_btn("Clear Filter", "#78909C")
        clear_btn.clicked.connect(self._on_browse_clear_filter)
        filter_row.addWidget(clear_btn)
        lay.addLayout(filter_row)

        self._browse_rows: list = []
        self._browse_find = ""
        self._browse_path_filter = ""
        self._browse_type_filter = "*"
        # Skip Preview for tiny text/code files (bytes)
        self._tiny_preview_bytes = 64

        self.table = QTableWidget(0, 8)
        self.table.setHorizontalHeaderLabels(
            [
                "ID",
                "File Name",
                "Type",
                "Size",
                "Captured",
                "Source kind",
                "Promoted",
                "Path",
            ]
        )
        self.table.setSelectionBehavior(QTableWidget.SelectionBehavior.SelectRows)
        self.table.setSelectionMode(QTableWidget.SelectionMode.ExtendedSelection)
        self.table.setEditTriggers(QTableWidget.EditTrigger.NoEditTriggers)
        self.table.setSortingEnabled(True)
        self.table.setAlternatingRowColors(True)
        self.table.horizontalHeader().setSectionResizeMode(1, QHeaderView.ResizeMode.Stretch)
        self.table.horizontalHeader().setSectionResizeMode(7, QHeaderView.ResizeMode.Stretch)
        self.table.horizontalHeader().setSectionsClickable(True)
        self.table.cellClicked.connect(self._on_row_clicked)
        lay.addWidget(self.table)
        return w

    def _build_preview_tab(self) -> QWidget:
        w = QWidget()
        lay = QVBoxLayout(w)
        self.preview_meta = QLabel("Select a row in Browse to preview.")
        lay.addWidget(self.preview_meta)

        self._web_view = QWebEngineView() if QWebEngineView is not None else None
        if self._web_view is not None and QWebEnginePage is not None:
            self._web_view.setPage(_QuietWebPage(self._web_view))
        self.image_view = QLabel()
        self.image_view.setAlignment(Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignCenter)
        self.image_view.setScaledContents(False)
        self.text_view = QTextEdit()
        self.text_view.setReadOnly(True)
        self.text_view.setFont(QFont("Consolas", 10))

        self.preview_stack = QStackedWidget()
        self.preview_stack.addWidget(self.text_view)  # 0
        self.preview_stack.addWidget(self.image_view)  # 1
        if self._web_view is not None:
            self.preview_stack.addWidget(self._web_view)  # 2
        lay.addWidget(self.preview_stack, stretch=1)
        return w

    def _build_open_url_tab(self, source_hint: str, query_hint: str) -> QWidget:
        w = QWidget()
        lay = QVBoxLayout(w)
        tip = QLabel(
            "Fetches HTML with requests (no browser extension). "
            "JS-heavy sites (e.g. Kaggle) may return only the shell page — "
            "use nav step 1 Repo / GitHub Fetch for code repos."
        )
        tip.setWordWrap(True)
        tip.setToolTip(tip.text())
        lay.addWidget(tip)

        row = QHBoxLayout()
        row.addWidget(QLabel("URL:"))
        self.url_edit = QLineEdit()
        default_url = self._default_url_for_source(source_hint, query_hint)
        self.url_edit.setText(default_url)
        self.url_edit.setPlaceholderText("https://github.com/owner/repo")
        row.addWidget(self.url_edit, stretch=1)
        lay.addLayout(row)

        opts = QHBoxLayout()
        opts.addWidget(QLabel("Page limit:"))
        self.link_limit = QLineEdit()
        self.link_limit.setText(str(int(self.cfg.get("crawl_link_limit", 10))))
        self.link_limit.setPlaceholderText("1–100 HTML pages")
        self.link_limit.setValidator(QIntValidator(1, 100, self))
        self.link_limit.setMaximumWidth(72)
        self.link_limit.setToolTip("Maximum HTML pages to save (including start URL). Type any value 1–100.")
        opts.addWidget(self.link_limit)
        opts.addWidget(QLabel("Levels:"))
        self.crawl_levels = QLineEdit()
        self.crawl_levels.setText(str(int(self.cfg.get("crawl_levels", 2))))
        self.crawl_levels.setPlaceholderText("1–10")
        self.crawl_levels.setValidator(QIntValidator(1, 10, self))
        self.crawl_levels.setMaximumWidth(48)
        self.crawl_levels.setToolTip(
            "Link depth: 1 = start URL only; 2 = start + linked pages; 3 = one more hop, etc."
        )
        opts.addWidget(self.crawl_levels)
        self.fetch_code_cb = QComboBox()
        self.fetch_code_cb.addItems(["Also fetch linked .py/.md", "HTML pages only"])
        opts.addWidget(self.fetch_code_cb)
        opts.addStretch()
        lay.addLayout(opts)

        btn_row = QHBoxLayout()
        self.crawl_btn = _action_btn("Crawl → crawl/", "#2E7D32")
        self.crawl_btn.setToolTip(f"Write files under {self.channel_folder}")
        self.crawl_btn.clicked.connect(self._start_crawl)
        btn_row.addWidget(self.crawl_btn)
        btn_row.addStretch()
        lay.addLayout(btn_row)
        lay.addStretch()
        return w

    def _build_import_tab(self) -> QWidget:

        lay = QVBoxLayout(w)
        tip = QLabel(

        folder_row.addWidget(self.pick_folder_btn)
        lay.addLayout(folder_row)

        btn_row = QHBoxLayout()
        self.import_btn = _action_btn("Import folder tree → DB", "#1565C0")

        self.import_btn.clicked.connect(self._start_import)

        btn_row.addWidget(self.reset_folder_btn)
        self.pick_html_btn = _action_btn("Pick file → captured_files", "#00838F")
        self.pick_html_btn.clicked.connect(self._pick_file_to_capture)
        btn_row.addWidget(self.pick_html_btn)
        btn_row.addStretch()
        lay.addLayout(btn_row)
        lay.addStretch()

    def _build_repo_tab(self, source_hint: str, query_hint: str) -> QWidget:

        dest_row.addWidget(self.repo_pick_dest_btn)

        btn_row = QHBoxLayout()
        self.repo_btn = _action_btn("Fetch repo → capture folder", "#6A1B9A")
        self.repo_btn.setToolTip(
            "Writes under Dest folder/<owner>_<repo>/. "
            "Drive root picks create <drive>\\captured_files first."
        )
        self.repo_btn.clicked.connect(self._start_repo_fetch)
        btn_row.addWidget(self.repo_btn)
        self.repo_import_btn = _action_btn("Then Import to DB", "#1565C0")
        self.repo_import_btn.clicked.connect(self._start_import_from_repo_dest)
        btn_row.addWidget(self.repo_import_btn)
        btn_row.addStretch()
        lay.addLayout(btn_row)
        lay.addStretch()
        return w

    # ── Actions ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    def _default_url_for_source(self, source_hint: str, query_hint: str) -> str:
        q = (query_hint or "").strip()
        if q.startswith("http://") or q.startswith("https://"):
            return q
        if "GitHub" in (source_hint or ""):
            if parse_github_repo(q):
                owner, repo, _ref = parse_github_repo(q)
                return f"https://github.com/{owner}/{repo}"
            return "https://github.com/"
        if "HuggingFace" in (source_hint or "") or "Hugging Face" in (source_hint or ""):
            return f"https://huggingface.co/{q}" if q else "https://huggingface.co/"
        if "Kaggle" in (source_hint or ""):
            return f"https://www.kaggle.com/{q}" if q else "https://www.kaggle.com/"
        return q or "https://github.com/"

    def _append_log(self, text: str):
        self.log.append(text.rstrip())

    def _set_busy(self, busy: bool):
        for b in (
            getattr(self, "crawl_btn", None),
            getattr(self, "import_btn", None),
            getattr(self, "repo_btn", None),
            self.refresh_btn,
            self.clear_btn,
            getattr(self, "pick_html_btn", None),
            getattr(self, "promote_btn", None),
            getattr(self, "pick_folder_btn", None),
            getattr(self, "reset_folder_btn", None),
            getattr(self, "repo_import_btn", None),
            getattr(self, "repo_pick_dest_btn", None),
            getattr(self, "repo_reset_dest_btn", None),
        ):
            if b is not None:
                b.setEnabled(not busy)

    def refresh_db_view(self):
        self._browse_rows = list(
            list_captures(self.cfg["database_path"], channel=self.channel)
        )
        self._populate_browse_table()

    def _on_browse_find(self):
        self._browse_find = (self.browse_find_input.text() or "").strip()
        self._populate_browse_table()

    def _on_browse_apply_filter(self):
        self._browse_path_filter = (self.browse_filter_input.text() or "").strip()
        self._browse_type_filter = (
            self.browse_type_combo.currentText() or "*"
        ).strip() or "*"
        self._populate_browse_table()

    def _on_browse_clear_filter(self):
        self.browse_find_input.clear()
        self.browse_filter_input.clear()
        self.browse_type_combo.setCurrentText("*")
        self._browse_find = ""
        self._browse_path_filter = ""
        self._browse_type_filter = "*"
        self._populate_browse_table()

    def _filtered_browse_rows(self) -> list:
        rows = list(self._browse_rows or [])
        path_f = (self._browse_path_filter or "").lower()
        type_f = (self._browse_type_filter or "*").lower().lstrip(".")
        find_f = (self._browse_find or "").lower()

        out = []
        for row in rows:
            # id, filename, filepath, filetype, captured_at, source_url, source_kind,
            # promoted_at, promoted_path, file_size
            filename = str(row[1] or "")
            filepath = str(row[2] or "")
            filetype = str(row[3] or "")
            captured = str(row[4] or "")
            source_url = str(row[5] or "") if len(row) > 5 else ""
            source_kind = str(row[6] or "") if len(row) > 6 else ""
            promoted = str(row[7] or "") if len(row) > 7 else ""
            promoted_path = str(row[8] or "") if len(row) > 8 else ""
            file_size = row[9] if len(row) > 9 else None

            if type_f and type_f != "*":
                ft = filetype.lower().lstrip(".")
                if ft != type_f and not filename.lower().endswith(f".{type_f}"):
                    continue

            if path_f:
                blob = f"{filename} {filepath}".lower()
                if path_f not in blob:
                    continue

            if find_f:
                hay = " ".join(
                    [
                        filename,
                        filepath,
                        filetype,
                        captured,
                        source_url,
                        source_kind,
                        promoted,
                        promoted_path,
                        str(row[0]),
                        format_file_size(file_size),
                        str(file_size or ""),
                    ]
                ).lower()
                if find_f not in hay:
                    continue

            out.append(row)
        return out

    def _populate_browse_table(self):
        rows = self._filtered_browse_rows()
        sorting = self.table.isSortingEnabled()
        self.table.setSortingEnabled(False)
        self.table.setRowCount(0)
        for row in rows:
            r = self.table.rowCount()
            self.table.insertRow(r)
            promoted = str(row[7] or "") if len(row) > 7 else ""
            file_size = row[9] if len(row) > 9 else None
            try:
                size_n = int(file_size) if file_size is not None else -1
            except (TypeError, ValueError):
                size_n = -1
            vals = [
                ("id", row[0]),
                ("text", str(row[1] or "")),
                ("text", str(row[3] or "")),
                ("size", size_n),
                ("text", str(row[4] or "")),
                ("text", str(row[6] or "")),
                ("text", promoted or "—"),
                ("text", str(row[2] or "")),
            ]
            for c, (kind, v) in enumerate(vals):
                item = QTableWidgetItem()
                if kind == "id":
                    try:
                        cid = int(v)
                    except (TypeError, ValueError):
                        cid = 0
                    item.setData(Qt.ItemDataRole.DisplayRole, cid)
                    item.setData(Qt.ItemDataRole.UserRole, cid)
                elif kind == "size":
                    item = _SizeTableItem(format_file_size(v if v >= 0 else None))
                    item.setData(Qt.ItemDataRole.EditRole, v if v >= 0 else -1)
                    item.setToolTip(f"{v} bytes" if v >= 0 else "")
                    self.table.setItem(r, c, item)
                    continue
                else:
                    item.setData(Qt.ItemDataRole.DisplayRole, v)
                if c == 6 and promoted:
                    item.setToolTip(str(row[8] if len(row) > 8 else promoted))
                self.table.setItem(r, c, item)
        self.table.setSortingEnabled(sorting)

        total = count_captures(self.cfg["database_path"], channel=self.channel)
        all_total = count_captures(self.cfg["database_path"])
        shown = len(rows)
        bits = [f"{total} {self.channel} capture(s)"]
        if all_total != total:
            bits.append(f"{all_total} total in DB")
        if shown != total:
            bits.append(f"showing {shown}")
        if self._browse_find:
            bits.append(f"find={self._browse_find!r}")
        if self._browse_path_filter or (
            self._browse_type_filter and self._browse_type_filter != "*"
        ):
            bits.append(
                f"filter path={self._browse_path_filter!r} type={self._browse_type_filter}"
            )
        self.status_lbl.setText(" · ".join(bits))

    def _on_row_clicked(self, row: int, _col: int):
        id_item = self.table.item(row, 0)
        if not id_item:
            return
        capture_id = id_item.data(Qt.ItemDataRole.UserRole)
        if capture_id is None:
            try:
                capture_id = int(id_item.text())
            except ValueError:
                return
        capture_id = int(capture_id)
        # Skip Preview for tiny text/code — size is the time saver
        db_row = get_capture_row(self.cfg["database_path"], capture_id)
        if db_row is not None:
            filetype = str(db_row[3] or "").lower().lstrip(".")
            file_size = db_row[9] if len(db_row) > 9 else None
            try:
                size_n = int(file_size) if file_size is not None else None
            except (TypeError, ValueError):
                size_n = None
            textish = {
                "md",
                "py",
                "txt",
                "rst",
                "json",
                "toml",
                "yml",
                "yaml",
                "css",
                "js",
                "html",
                "htm",
                "sql",
            }
            thresh = int(getattr(self, "_tiny_preview_bytes", 64))
            if filetype in textish and size_n is not None and size_n < thresh:
                self._append_log(
                    f"Skip Preview #{capture_id} ({db_row[1]}): "
                    f"{format_file_size(size_n)} < {thresh} B — tiny text file"
                )
                self.status_lbl.setText(
                    f"Skipped tiny preview: #{capture_id} {format_file_size(size_n)}"
                )
                return
        self._preview_capture(capture_id)
        self.tabs.setCurrentIndex(self._preview_tab_index)

    def _preview_capture(self, capture_id: int):
        row = get_capture_row(self.cfg["database_path"], capture_id)
        content = get_capture_content(self.cfg["database_path"], capture_id)
        if not row or content is None:
            self.preview_meta.setText("No content.")
            return
        filename, filetype = row[1], (row[3] or "").lower()
        size = row[9] if len(row) > 9 else None
        size_txt = format_file_size(size)
        self.preview_meta.setText(
            f"#{capture_id}  {filename}  ({filetype})  ·  {size_txt}"
        )
        ext = f".{filetype}" if filetype and not filetype.startswith(".") else (filetype or ".bin")
        path = write_temp_preview(content, capture_id, ext, self._temp_dir)
        self._show_preview_path(path, filetype)

    def _show_preview_path(self, path: str, filetype: str):
        ft = (filetype or "").lower().lstrip(".")
        if ft in ("png", "jpg", "jpeg", "gif", "webp", "bmp"):
            pix = QPixmap(path)
            self.image_view.setPixmap(
                pix.scaled(
                    900,
                    700,
                    Qt.AspectRatioMode.KeepAspectRatio,
                    Qt.TransformationMode.SmoothTransformation,
                )
            )
            self.preview_stack.setCurrentIndex(1)
            return
        if ft in ("html", "htm") and self._web_view is not None:
            try:
                self._ensure_preview_server()
                name = os.path.basename(path)
                # Serve from temp dir
                url = QUrl(f"http://127.0.0.1:{self._preview_port}/{name}")
                self._web_view.setUrl(url)
                self.preview_stack.setCurrentIndex(2)
                return
            except Exception as e:
                self._append_log(f"HTML preview fallback: {e}")
        # Text fallback
        try:
            with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as f:
                self.text_view.setPlainText(f.read())
        except OSError:
            self.text_view.setPlainText(repr(path))
        self.preview_stack.setCurrentIndex(0)

    def _ensure_preview_server(self):
        if self._preview_server is not None:
            return
        os.makedirs(self._temp_dir, exist_ok=True)
        httpd, port, _thread = start_preview_server(self._temp_dir)
        self._preview_server = httpd
        self._preview_port = port

    def _open_capture_folder(self):
        path = self.channel_folder
        ensure_capture_folder(path)
        QDesktopServices.openUrl(QUrl.fromLocalFile(path))

    def _clear_data(self):
        n = count_captures(self.cfg["database_path"], channel=self.channel)
        all_n = count_captures(self.cfg["database_path"])
        if self.mode == "repo":
            msg = (
                f"Delete all {all_n} row(s) and batch history from uieg_capture.db?\n"
                f"({n} are repo channel — Clear wipes the whole DB.)\n"
                "(Does not delete files on disk.)"
            )
        else:
            msg = (
                f"Delete all {all_n} row(s) and batch history from uieg_capture.db?\n"
                f"({n} are crawl channel — Clear wipes the whole DB.)\n"
                "(Does not delete files on disk.)"
            )
        reply = QMessageBox.question(self, "Clear Data", msg)
        if reply != QMessageBox.StandardButton.Yes:
            return
        clear_database(self.cfg["database_path"])
        self._append_log("Database cleared.")
        self.refresh_db_view()

    def _selected_capture_ids(self) -> list:
        ids = []
        for idx in self.table.selectionModel().selectedRows():
            item = self.table.item(idx.row(), 0)
            if not item:
                continue
            cid = item.data(Qt.ItemDataRole.UserRole)
            if cid is None:
                try:
                    cid = int(item.text())
                except ValueError:
                    continue
            ids.append(int(cid))
        return ids

    def _promote_selected(self):
        ids = self._selected_capture_ids()
        if not ids:
            QMessageBox.information(
                self,
                "Promote",
                "Select one or more Browse rows first.",
            )
            return
        reply = QMessageBox.question(
            self,
            "Promote to Ship's Computer",
            f"Promote {len(ids)} capture(s) into ship_computer.db?\n\n"
            "Files are written under promoted_research/ and ingested with the "
            "universal extractor (embeddings required for RAG).\n"
            "Ask AI / Deep Dive will see them after a successful ingest.",
        )
        if reply != QMessageBox.StandardButton.Yes:
            return

        db_path = self.cfg["database_path"]
        promoted_folder = self.cfg.get("promoted_folder") or ""

        def work(log):
            return promote_captures(
                db_path,
                ids,
                promoted_folder,
                log=log,
            )

        def done(result):
            ok_n, fail_n, _msgs = result if result else (0, 0, [])
            self.refresh_db_view()
            self._append_log(f"Promote done: {ok_n} ok, {fail_n} failed.")
            if fail_n:
                QMessageBox.warning(
                    self,
                    "Promote",
                    f"Promoted {ok_n}; {fail_n} failed. See log for details.",
                )
            else:
                QMessageBox.information(
                    self,
                    "Promote",
                    f"Promoted {ok_n} capture(s) to Ship's Computer.",
                )

        self._run_worker(work, on_ok=done)

    def _start_crawl(self):
        url = self.url_edit.text().strip()
        if not url:
            QMessageBox.warning(self, "Open URL", "Enter a URL.")
            return
        if not url.startswith(("http://", "https://")):
            url = "https://" + url
        link_limit = int((self.link_limit.text() or "10").strip() or "10")
        crawl_levels = int((self.crawl_levels.text() or "2").strip() or "2")
        fetch_code = self.fetch_code_cb.currentIndex() == 0
        capture_folder = self.channel_folder
        timeout = int(self.cfg.get("crawl_timeout_sec", 15))

        def work(log):
            return crawl_url_to_disk(
                url,
                capture_folder,
                link_limit=link_limit,
                crawl_levels=crawl_levels,
                timeout_sec=timeout,
                fetch_code_links=fetch_code,
                log=log,
            )

        def done(paths):
            self._append_log(
                f"Crawl wrote {len(paths or [])} file(s) under {capture_folder}. "
                "Use Import to load DB."
            )
            if getattr(self, "import_folder_edit", None) is not None:
                self.import_folder_edit.setText(capture_folder)

        self._run_worker(work, on_ok=done)

    def _pick_import_folder(self):
        start = (self.import_folder_edit.text() or "").strip() or self.channel_folder
        if not os.path.isdir(start):
            start = self.channel_folder
        path = QFileDialog.getExistingDirectory(
            self,
            "Pick folder to import",
            start,
        )
        if path:
            self.import_folder_edit.setText(path)
            self._append_log(f"Import folder set: {path}")

    def _reset_import_folder(self):
        self.import_folder_edit.setText(self.channel_folder)
        self._append_log(f"Import folder reset to crawl/: {self.channel_folder}")

    def _start_import(
        self,
        *,
        folder: Optional[str] = None,
        batch_label: Optional[str] = None,
        source_url: Optional[str] = None,
    ):
        if not folder and getattr(self, "import_folder_edit", None) is not None:
            folder = self.import_folder_edit.text().strip()
        if not folder:
            folder = self.channel_folder
        if not os.path.isdir(folder):
            QMessageBox.warning(
                self,
                "Import",
                f"Folder not found:\n{folder}\n\nUse Browse… to pick a folder.",
            )
            return
        db_path = self.cfg["database_path"]
        kind = "manual_import" if self.mode == "crawl" else "repo_file"
        label = batch_label
        if not label:
            if self.mode == "crawl" and getattr(self, "url_edit", None) is not None:
                label = (self.url_edit.text() or "").strip() or "crawl import"
            elif self.mode == "repo" and getattr(self, "repo_edit", None) is not None:
                label = (self.repo_edit.text() or "").strip() or "repo import"
            else:
                label = os.path.basename(folder.rstrip("\\/")) or self.channel

        def work(log):
            return import_captured_files(
                folder,
                db_path,
                channel=self.channel,
                batch_label=label,
                source_kind=kind,
                source_url=source_url or label,
                log=log,
            )

        def done(n):
            self.refresh_db_view()
            self._append_log(f"Imported {n} file(s) from {folder}")

        self._run_worker(work, on_ok=done)

    def _pick_file_to_capture(self):
        path, _ = QFileDialog.getOpenFileName(
            self,
            "Pick file to capture",
            "",
            "Web/Text (*.html *.htm *.md *.py *.txt);;All (*.*)",
        )
        if not path:
            return
        dest = copy_local_file_to_capture(
            path, self.channel_folder, log=self._append_log
        )
        if dest:
            QMessageBox.information(
                self,
                "Captured",
                f"Copied to:\n{dest}\n\nUse Import to load into the DB.",
            )

    def _pick_repo_dest_folder(self):
        start = (self.repo_dest_edit.text() or "").strip() or self.channel_folder
        if not os.path.isdir(start):
            drive, _ = os.path.splitdrive(os.path.abspath(start))
            start = (drive + os.sep) if drive else self.channel_folder
        path = QFileDialog.getExistingDirectory(
            self,
            "Pick destination folder for repo fetch",
            start,
        )
        if not path:
            return
        resolved = resolve_repo_capture_folder(path)
        self.repo_dest_edit.setText(resolved)
        if os.path.normcase(os.path.abspath(path)) != os.path.normcase(resolved):
            self._append_log(
                f"Drive root selected ({path}) — using {resolved}"
            )
        else:
            self._append_log(f"Repo dest folder: {resolved}")

    def _reset_repo_dest_folder(self):
        self.repo_dest_edit.setText(self.channel_folder)
        self._append_log(f"Repo dest reset to repos/: {self.channel_folder}")

    def _resolved_repo_dest(self) -> str:
        raw = ""
        if getattr(self, "repo_dest_edit", None) is not None:
            raw = self.repo_dest_edit.text().strip()
        if not raw:
            raw = self.channel_folder
        resolved = resolve_repo_capture_folder(raw)
        if getattr(self, "repo_dest_edit", None) is not None:
            self.repo_dest_edit.setText(resolved)
        return resolved

    def _start_repo_fetch(self):
        spec = self.repo_edit.text().strip()
        if not spec:
            QMessageBox.warning(self, "Repo", "Enter owner/repo or GitHub URL.")
            return
        method_map = {0: "auto", 1: "git", 2: "zip"}
        method = method_map.get(self.repo_method.currentIndex(), "auto")
        capture_folder = self._resolved_repo_dest()
        exts = self.cfg.get("repo_extensions") or None

        def work(log):
            return fetch_repo_to_capture(
                spec,
                capture_folder,
                method=method,
                extensions=exts,
                log=log,
            )

        def done(paths):
            n = len(paths or [])
            self._append_log(
                f"Repo fetch wrote {n} file(s) under {capture_folder}. "
                "Use Then Import to DB (or Import tab) to load."
            )
            # Point Import folder at the same dest for one-click follow-up
            if getattr(self, "import_folder_edit", None) is not None:
                self.import_folder_edit.setText(capture_folder)

        self._run_worker(work, on_ok=done)

    def _start_import_from_repo_dest(self):
        """Import from the Repo dest folder (after fetch)."""
        folder = self._resolved_repo_dest()
        spec = (self.repo_edit.text() or "").strip() if getattr(self, "repo_edit", None) else ""
        self._start_import(
            folder=folder,
            batch_label=spec or "repo import",
            source_url=spec or None,
        )

    def _run_worker(self, fn, on_ok=None):
        if self._worker is not None and self._worker.isRunning():
            QMessageBox.information(self, "Busy", "A capture job is already running.")
            return
        self._set_busy(True)
        self._worker = _Worker(fn, self)
        self._worker.log_line.connect(self._append_log)
        self._worker.failed.connect(self._on_worker_fail)
        if on_ok:
            self._worker.finished_ok.connect(on_ok)
        self._worker.finished.connect(lambda: self._set_busy(False))
        self._worker.start()

    def _on_worker_fail(self, err: str):
        self._append_log(f"ERROR: {err}")
        QMessageBox.critical(self, "Capture failed", err)

    def apply_theme(self):
        self.setStyleSheet(_panel_stylesheet(self.theme))

    def prepare_shutdown(self):
        if self._preview_server is not None:
            try:
                self._preview_server.shutdown()
            except Exception:
                pass
            self._preview_server = None

    def crawl_url_to_disk(
    url: str,
    capture_folder: str,
    *,
    link_limit: int = 10,
    crawl_levels: int = 2,
    timeout_sec: int = 15,
    fetch_code_links: bool = True,
    code_exts: Optional[Set[str]] = None,
    log: Optional[LogFn] = None,
) -> List[str]:
    """BFS crawl: start URL + same-host pages up to crawl_levels deep.

    link_limit caps total HTML pages saved (including the start URL).
    crawl_levels=1 fetches only the start URL; 2 = start + one link hop; etc.
    Returns list of written file paths.
    """
    missing = missing_crawler_deps()
    if missing:
        raise RuntimeError(missing_deps_message(missing, "Crawl to disk"))
    _log = log or (lambda _m: None)
    os.makedirs(capture_folder, exist_ok=True)
    code_exts = code_exts or {".py", ".md", ".txt", ".rst"}
    written: List[str] = []
    written_urls: Set[str] = set()
    session = requests.Session()
    session.headers["User-Agent"] = USER_AGENT

    max_pages = max(1, int(link_limit))
    max_depth = max(0, int(crawl_levels) - 1)

    def fetch_text(u: str) -> Optional[str]:
        try:
            r = session.get(u, timeout=timeout_sec)
            r.raise_for_status()
            r.encoding = r.encoding or "utf-8"
            return r.text
        except Exception as e:
            _log(f"Fetch failed for {u}: {e}")
            return None

    def fetch_bytes(u: str) -> Optional[bytes]:
        try:
            r = session.get(u, timeout=timeout_sec)
            r.raise_for_status()
            return r.content
        except Exception as e:
            _log(f"Fetch failed for {u}: {e}")
            return None

    def save_html(page_url: str, html: str) -> Optional[str]:
        if page_url in written_urls:
            return None
        fname = _safe_filename_from_url(page_url, ".html")
        if not fname.endswith(".html"):
            fname = os.path.splitext(fname)[0] + ".html"
        stem, ext = os.path.splitext(fname)
        fpath = os.path.join(capture_folder, fname)
        n = 2
        while os.path.exists(fpath):
            fname = f"{stem}_{n}{ext}"
            fpath = os.path.join(capture_folder, fname)
            n += 1
        with open(fpath, "w", encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as f:
            f.write(html)
        written_urls.add(page_url)
        written.append(fpath)
        _log(f"Saved {fname}")
        return fpath

    start = _normalize_url(url)
    if not start.startswith(("http://", "https://")):
        start = "https://" + start.lstrip("/")

    _log(
        f"Crawling {start} -> {capture_folder} "
        f"(levels={crawl_levels}, page cap={max_pages})"
    )

    queue: Deque[Tuple[str, int]] = deque([(start, 0)])
    seen: Set[str] = {start}
    first_html: Optional[str] = None

    while queue and len(written) < max_pages:
        cur_url, depth = queue.popleft()
        html = fetch_text(cur_url)
        if not html:
            continue
        save_html(cur_url, html)
        if cur_url == start:
            first_html = html
        if depth >= max_depth or len(written) >= max_pages:
            continue
        for link in _extract_same_host_links(cur_url, html):
            if link in seen:
                continue
            if len(written) + len(queue) >= max_pages:
                break
            seen.add(link)
            queue.append((link, depth + 1))

    if fetch_code_links and first_html:
        code_links: List[Tuple[str, str]] = []
        seen_raw: Set[str] = set()
        soup = _soup(first_html)
        for a in soup.find_all("a", href=True):
            full = urljoin(start, a["href"])
            ext = os.path.splitext(urlparse(full).path)[1].lower()
            if ext not in code_exts:
                continue
            raw = to_raw_github_url(full)
            if raw in seen_raw:
                continue
            seen_raw.add(raw)
            code_links.append((os.path.basename(urlparse(full).path) or f"file{ext}", raw))

        for fname, raw_url in code_links[:20]:
            content = fetch_bytes(raw_url)
            if not content:
                continue
            fpath = os.path.join(capture_folder, fname)
            if os.path.exists(fpath):
                base, ext = os.path.splitext(fname)
                fpath = os.path.join(capture_folder, f"{base}_raw{ext}")
                fname = os.path.basename(fpath)
            with open(fpath, "wb") as f:
                f.write(content)
            written.append(fpath)
            _log(f"Saved code {fname}")

    _log(
        f"Crawl complete — {len(written)} file(s) on disk "
        f"({len(written_urls)} HTML page(s)). Import to load DB."
    )
    return written

    def snapshot_url_to_html(
    url: str,
    dest_path: str,
    *,
    timeout_sec: int = 15,
    log: Optional[LogFn] = None,
) -> str:
    """Fetch one URL and write an offline .html snapshot (SingleFile-spirit, no browser).

    Returns the written dest_path. Raises OSError / RuntimeError on failure.
    """
    _log = log or (lambda _m: None)
    target = to_raw_github_url((url or "").strip())
    if not target:
        raise RuntimeError("No URL to snapshot.")

    dest = dest_path
    if not dest.lower().endswith((".html", ".htm")):
        dest = dest + ".html"
    parent = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(dest))
    if parent:
        os.makedirs(parent, exist_ok=True)

    # Local file:// or plain path — copy/read without HTTP
    local_path = ""
    if target.lower().startswith("file:"):
        try:
            from urllib.parse import unquote, urlparse

            local_path = unquote(urlparse(target).path)
            if os.name == "nt" and local_path.startswith("/") and len(local_path) > 2 and local_path[2] == ":":
                local_path = local_path[1:]
        except Exception:
            local_path = ""
    elif os.path.isfile(target):
        local_path = target

    if local_path and os.path.isfile(local_path):
        _log(f"Copying local HTML {local_path} -> {dest}")
        with open(local_path, "r", encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as f:
            html = f.read()
        with open(dest, "w", encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as f:
            f.write(html)
        return dest

    if not target.startswith(("http://", "https://")):
        raise RuntimeError(f"Unsupported URL for HTML snapshot:\n{target}")

    session = requests.Session()
    session.headers["User-Agent"] = USER_AGENT
    _log(f"Snapshot {target} -> {dest}")
    try:
        r = session.get(target, timeout=timeout_sec)
        r.raise_for_status()
        r.encoding = r.encoding or "utf-8"
        html = r.text
    except Exception as e:
        raise RuntimeError(f"Fetch failed for {target}: {e}") from e

    # Light SingleFile-spirit touch: ensure charset meta so offline open is readable
    if html and "<meta" in html.lower() and "charset" not in html.lower()[:800]:
        insert = '<meta charset="utf-8">'
        lower = html.lower()
        idx = lower.find("<head>")
        if idx >= 0:
            html = html[: idx + 6] + insert + html[idx + 6 :]
        else:
            html = insert + html

    with open(dest, "w", encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as f:
        f.write(html)
    _log(f"Saved {os.path.basename(dest)}")
    return dest

    def format_file_size(n: Optional[int]) -> str:
    """Human-readable size for Browse grid."""
    if n is None:
        return "—"
    try:
        size = int(n)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return "—"
    if size < 0:
        return "—"
    if size < 1024:
        return f"{size} B"
    if size < 1024 * 1024:
        return f"{size / 1024:.1f} KB"
    return f"{size / (1024 * 1024):.1f} MB"

    def format_uieg_status_report(db_path: str) -> str:
    """Plain-text recap of uieg_capture.db for the UIEG Status center pane."""
    info = summarize_uieg_db(db_path)
    if info.get("error") and not info.get("exists"):
        return info["error"]
    if info.get("error"):
        return f"Error reading database:\n{info['error']}"

    lines = [
        "UIEG CAPTURE - STATUS",
        "",
        f"  Database:  {os.path.basename(info['db_path'])}",
        f"  Path:      {info['db_path']}",
        f"  Size:      {info['size_mb']:.2f} MB",
        f"  Captures:  {info['total']}",
        f"  Promoted:  {info['promoted']}  (via Promote to Ship's Computer)",
        "",
        "  By source_kind:",
    ]
    by_kind = info.get("by_kind") or {}
    if not by_kind:
        lines.append("    (none)")
    else:
        for k, n in by_kind.items():
            lines.append(f"    {k:<24} {n:>6d}")

    lines.extend(["", "  By channel (workflow):"])
    by_channel = info.get("by_channel") or {}
    if not by_channel:
        lines.append("    (none)")
    else:
        for k, n in by_channel.items():
            lines.append(f"    {k:<24} {n:>6d}")

    batches = info.get("batches") or []
    lines.extend(["", "  Recent batches:", ""])
    if not batches:
        lines.append("    (none — import after crawl or repo fetch)")
    else:
        lines.append(f"  {'ID':>4}  {'Ch':<6}  {'Files':>5}  {'Label':<28}  Created")
        lines.append(f"  {'-' * 4}  {'-' * 6}  {'-' * 5}  {'-' * 28}  {'-' * 19}")
        for b in batches:
            lines.append(
                f"  {int(b.get('id') or 0):>4}  "
                f"{str(b.get('channel') or ''):<6}  "
                f"{int(b.get('file_count') or 0):>5}  "
                f"{str(b.get('label') or ''):<28}  "
                f"{str(b.get('created_at') or '')}"
            )

    lines.extend(["", "  Repos in DB:", ""])
    repos = info.get("repos") or []
    if not repos:
        lines.append("    (no repo-like captures found - fetch a repo then Import)")
    else:
        lines.append(
            f"  {'Repo':<36} {'Files':>6}  {'Promoted':<16}  Kind / URL"
        )
        lines.append(
            f"  {'-' * 36} {'-' * 6}  {'-' * 16}  {'-' * 36}"
        )
        for r in repos:
            slug = str(r.get("slug") or "")
            url = str(r.get("source_url") or "")
            kind = str(r.get("kind_summary") or "-")
            promo = str(r.get("promoted_status") or "-")
            extra = url or kind
            lines.append(
                f"  {slug:<36} {int(r.get('files') or 0):>6d}  {promo:<16}  {extra}"
            )

    return "\n".join(lines)

    def get_capture_row(db_path: str, capture_id: int) -> Optional[Tuple]:

        conn.close()

    def summarize_uieg_db(db_path: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """Return overview + repo list for UIEG Status panel."""
    from collections import Counter, defaultdict

    out: Dict[str, Any] = {
        "exists": False,
        "db_path": db_path,
        "size_mb": 0.0,
        "total": 0,
        "promoted": 0,
        "by_kind": {},
        "by_channel": {},
        "batches": [],
        "repos": [],
        "error": None,
    }
    if not os.path.isfile(db_path):
        out["error"] = f"Database not found:\n{db_path}"
        return out
    out["exists"] = True
    try:
        out["size_mb"] = os.path.getsize(db_path) / (1024 * 1024)
    except OSError:
        pass
    try:
        conn = sqlite3.connect(db_path, timeout=5)
        try:
            total = conn.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM captures").fetchone()[0]
            promoted = conn.execute(
                "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM captures WHERE promoted_at IS NOT NULL AND promoted_at != ''"
            ).fetchone()[0]
            kinds = conn.execute(
                """
                SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(source_kind), ''), '(none)'), COUNT(*)
                FROM captures GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC
                """
            ).fetchall()
            channels = conn.execute(
                """
                SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(channel), ''), '(none)'), COUNT(*)
                FROM captures GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC
                """
            ).fetchall()
            batch_rows = conn.execute(
                """
                SELECT id, channel, label, source_url, disk_root, created_at, file_count
                FROM capture_batches
                ORDER BY id DESC
                LIMIT 15
                """
            ).fetchall()
            rows = conn.execute(
                """
                SELECT source_url, source_kind, filepath, filename, promoted_at, channel
                FROM captures
                """
            ).fetchall()
        finally:
            conn.close()
    except Exception as e:
        out["error"] = str(e)
        return out

    out["total"] = int(total or 0)
    out["promoted"] = int(promoted or 0)
    out["by_kind"] = {str(k): int(n) for k, n in kinds}
    out["by_channel"] = {str(k): int(n) for k, n in channels}
    out["batches"] = [
        {
            "id": int(b[0]),
            "channel": str(b[1] or ""),
            "label": str(b[2] or ""),
            "source_url": str(b[3] or ""),
            "disk_root": str(b[4] or ""),
            "created_at": str(b[5] or ""),
            "file_count": int(b[6] or 0),
        }
        for b in batch_rows
    ]

    repo_files: Dict[str, int] = defaultdict(int)
    repo_promoted: Dict[str, int] = defaultdict(int)
    repo_meta: Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]] = {}
    for source_url, source_kind, filepath, filename, promoted_at, channel in rows:
        if str(channel or "") == CHANNEL_CRAWL:
            continue
        slug = _github_slug_from_url(str(source_url or ""))
        if not slug:
            slug = _repo_key_from_filepath(str(filepath or "")) or _repo_key_from_filepath(
                str(filename or "")
            )
        if not slug:
            continue
        repo_files[slug] += 1
        is_promoted = bool(str(promoted_at or "").strip())
        if is_promoted:
            repo_promoted[slug] += 1
        meta = repo_meta.setdefault(
            slug,
            {
                "slug": slug,
                "files": 0,
                "promoted_files": 0,
                "source_url": "",
                "kinds": Counter(),
            },
        )
        meta["files"] = repo_files[slug]
        meta["promoted_files"] = repo_promoted[slug]
        if source_url and not meta["source_url"]:
            meta["source_url"] = str(source_url)
        if source_kind:
            meta["kinds"][str(source_kind)] += 1

    repos = sorted(repo_meta.values(), key=lambda r: (-int(r["files"]), str(r["slug"])))
    for r in repos:
        kinds_c = r.pop("kinds")
        r["kind_summary"] = ", ".join(f"{k}:{n}" for k, n in kinds_c.most_common(4)) or "-"
        files = int(r.get("files") or 0)
        promoted_n = int(r.get("promoted_files") or 0)
        if files <= 0:
            r["promoted_status"] = "-"
        elif promoted_n <= 0:
            r["promoted_status"] = "no"
        elif promoted_n >= files:
            r["promoted_status"] = "yes"
        else:
            r["promoted_status"] = f"partial ({promoted_n}/{files})"
    out["repos"] = repos
    return out

    def copy_local_file_to_capture(
    src_path: str,
    capture_folder: str,
    *,
    log: Optional[LogFn] = None,
) -> Optional[str]:
    """Copy a user-picked file into captured_files. Returns dest path."""
    _log = log or (lambda _m: None)
    if not os.path.isfile(src_path):
        _log("File not found.")
        return None
    os.makedirs(capture_folder, exist_ok=True)
    dest = os.path.join(capture_folder, os.path.basename(src_path))
    if os.path.abspath(src_path) != os.path.abspath(dest):
        shutil.copy2(src_path, dest)
    _log(f"Copied -> {dest}")
    return dest

    def import_captured_files(
    capture_folder: str,
    db_path: str,
    *,
    channel: str = CHANNEL_CRAWL,
    batch_id: Optional[int] = None,
    batch_label: Optional[str] = None,
    extensions: Optional[Set[str]] = None,
    source_kind: Optional[str] = None,
    source_url: Optional[str] = None,
    skip_existing: bool = True,
    log: Optional[LogFn] = None,
) -> int:
    """Scan capture_folder recursively; insert new files into DB. Returns count inserted."""
    _log = log or (lambda _m: None)
    exts = {e.lower() if e.startswith(".") else f".{e.lower()}" for e in (extensions or DEFAULT_IMPORT_EXTS)}
    if not os.path.isdir(capture_folder):
        _log(f"Capture folder missing: {capture_folder}")
        return 0

    kind = _default_source_kind(channel, source_kind)
    if batch_id is None:
        label = (batch_label or os.path.basename(capture_folder.rstrip("\\/")) or channel).strip()
        batch_id = create_batch(
            db_path,
            channel,
            label,
            source_url=source_url,
            disk_root=capture_folder,
        )
        _log(f"Created batch #{batch_id} ({channel}) — {label}")

    inserted = 0
    for root, dirs, files in os.walk(capture_folder):
        dirs[:] = [d for d in dirs if d not in SKIP_DIR_NAMES and not d.startswith(".")]
        # Skip raw git clone trees under _repos (extracted copies live elsewhere)
        if os.path.basename(root) == "_repos" or f"{os.sep}_repos{os.sep}" in (root + os.sep):
            dirs.clear()
            continue
        for name in files:
            if name.startswith("."):
                continue
            ext = os.path.splitext(name)[1].lower()
            if ext not in exts:
                continue
            fpath = os.path.join(root, name)
            filename = _rel_filename(capture_folder, fpath)
            if skip_existing and file_exists_in_db(db_path, filename):
                continue
            try:
                with open(fpath, "rb") as f:
                    content = f.read()
            except OSError as e:
                _log(f"Skip {filename}: {e}")
                continue
            filetype = ext.lstrip(".") or "bin"
            insert_capture(
                db_path,
                filename,
                fpath,
                filetype,
                content,
                source_url=source_url,
                source_kind=kind,
                batch_id=batch_id,
                channel=channel,
            )
            inserted += 1
            _log(f"Imported {filename}")
    update_batch_file_count(db_path, batch_id, inserted)
    _log(f"Import done — {inserted} new row(s) in batch #{batch_id}.")
    return inserted

    def auto_backup_before_reset(db_path: str, tag: str) -> str:
    """Create a pre-reset backup; returns path."""
    if not os.path.isfile(db_path):
        init_db(db_path)
        return ""
    ts = datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
    backup_path = os.path.join(
        backup_dir_for(db_path), f"{UIEG_BACKUP_PREFIX}pre_reset_{tag}_{ts}.db"
    )
    src = sqlite3.connect(db_path, timeout=30)
    try:
        dst = sqlite3.connect(backup_path)
        try:
            src.backup(dst)
        finally:
            dst.close()
    finally:
        src.close()
    return backup_path

    def reindex_db(db_path: str) -> None:
    """Run ANALYZE then VACUUM on uieg_capture.db."""
    if not os.path.isfile(db_path):
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"Database not found: {db_path}")
    conn = sqlite3.connect(db_path, timeout=30)
    try:
        conn.execute("ANALYZE")
        conn.commit()
    finally:
        conn.close()
    vac = sqlite3.connect(db_path, timeout=120)
    try:
        vac.execute("VACUUM")
    finally:
        vac.close()

    def reset_channel(db_path: str, channel: str) -> Tuple[int, int]:
    """Delete captures and batches for one channel. Returns (captures, batches)."""
    if channel not in (CHANNEL_CRAWL, CHANNEL_REPO):
        raise ValueError(f"Unknown channel: {channel}")
    conn = sqlite3.connect(db_path, timeout=30)
    try:
        cap = conn.execute(
            "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM captures WHERE channel = ?", (channel,)
        ).fetchone()[0]
        bat = conn.execute(
            "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM capture_batches WHERE channel = ?", (channel,)
        ).fetchone()[0]
        conn.execute("DELETE FROM captures WHERE channel = ?", (channel,))
        conn.execute("DELETE FROM capture_batches WHERE channel = ?", (channel,))
        conn.commit()
        return int(cap or 0), int(bat or 0)
    finally:
        conn.close()

    def restore_db(db_path: str, backup_name: str) -> None:
    """Overwrite uieg_capture.db from a named backup file."""
    src = os.path.join(backup_dir_for(db_path), backup_name)
    if not os.path.isfile(src):
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"Backup not found: {src}")
    for suffix in ("", "-wal", "-shm"):
        target = db_path + suffix if suffix else db_path
        if os.path.exists(target):
            os.remove(target)
    shutil.copy2(src, db_path)
    init_db(db_path)

    def is_drive_root(path: str) -> bool:
    """True for Windows drive roots like D:\\ or D:/ (and Unix /)."""
    if not path or not str(path).strip():
        return False
    ap = os.path.abspath(path.strip())
    drive, tail = os.path.splitdrive(ap)
    if drive:
        return tail in ("\\", "/", "")
    # Unix root
    return ap == os.sep

    def migrate_legacy_db(database_path: str) -> Tuple[bool, str]:
    """Rename/copy ueig_capture.db → uieg_capture.db if needed.

    Returns (did_migrate, message).
    """
    target = database_path
    if os.path.isfile(target):
        return False, "uieg_capture.db already present"

    search_dirs = [
        SCRIPT_DIR,
        os.path.dirname(target),
        os.path.join(os.path.dirname(SCRIPT_DIR), "Spock-To-Bridge-UIEG-Scanner"),
        r"D:\Spock-To-Bridge-UIEG-Scanner",
    ]
    for d in search_dirs:
        if not d or not os.path.isdir(d):
            continue
        for legacy_name in LEGACY_DB_NAMES:
            legacy = os.path.join(d, legacy_name)
            if os.path.isfile(legacy) and os.path.abspath(legacy) != os.path.abspath(target):
                os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(target) or ".", exist_ok=True)
                try:
                    # Prefer rename when same directory; else copy
                    if os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(legacy)) == os.path.dirname(
                        os.path.abspath(target)
                    ):
                        os.rename(legacy, target)
                        return True, f"Renamed {legacy_name} → {os.path.basename(target)}"
                    shutil.copy2(legacy, target)
                    return True, f"Copied {legacy} → {target}"
                except OSError as e:
                    return False, f"Migration failed: {e}"
    return False, "No legacy ueig_capture.db found"

    def resolve_repo_capture_folder(path: str, *, folder_name: str = "captured_files") -> str:
    """Normalize a user-picked dest for repo fetch.

    If the pick is a drive root (e.g. D:\\), create <drive>\\captured_files and use that
    so files are not dumped at the root of the volume. When the pick is the capture root
    or ends with captured_files, ensure repos/ exists and return it.
    """
    raw = (path or "").strip() or DEFAULT_CAPTURE_FOLDER
    ap = os.path.abspath(raw)
    if is_drive_root(ap):
        drive, _ = os.path.splitdrive(ap)
        if drive:
            dest = os.path.join(drive + os.sep, folder_name)
        else:
            dest = os.path.join(os.sep, folder_name)
        os.makedirs(dest, exist_ok=True)
        return default_repo_folder(dest)
    os.makedirs(ap, exist_ok=True)
    base_name = os.path.basename(ap.rstrip("\\/"))
    if base_name == folder_name or ap == os.path.abspath(DEFAULT_CAPTURE_FOLDER):
        return default_repo_folder(ap)
    return ap

    def promote_capture(
    db_path: str,
    capture_id: int,
    promoted_folder: str,
    *,
    python_exe: Optional[str] = None,
    log: Optional[LogFn] = None,
) -> Tuple[bool, str]:
    """Promote one capture. Returns (ok, message)."""
    _log = log or (lambda _m: None)
    init_db(db_path)
    row = get_capture_row(db_path, capture_id)
    content = get_capture_content(db_path, capture_id)
    if not row or content is None:
        return False, f"#{capture_id}: not found or empty"

    filename = row[1] or f"capture_{capture_id}"
    already = row[7] if len(row) > 7 else None
    if already:
        _log(f"#{capture_id}: already promoted at {row[8] if len(row) > 8 else already}")
        # Allow re-promote with --reprocess via overwrite + extract
        _log(f"#{capture_id}: re-promoting…")

    dest_dir = ensure_promoted_folder(promoted_folder)
    dest_name = _safe_name(filename, capture_id)
    dest_path = os.path.join(dest_dir, dest_name)
    try:
        with open(dest_path, "wb") as f:
            f.write(content if isinstance(content, (bytes, bytearray)) else bytes(content))
    except OSError as e:
        return False, f"#{capture_id}: write failed: {e}"

    py = python_exe or sys.executable
    if not os.path.isfile(EXTRACTOR):
        return False, f"Extractor not found: {EXTRACTOR}"

    try:
        result = subprocess.run(
            [py, EXTRACTOR, dest_path, "--reprocess"],
            cwd=SCRIPT_DIR,
            capture_output=True,
            text=True,
            encoding="utf-8",
            errors="replace",
            timeout=600,
        )
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        return False, f"#{capture_id}: extractor timed out"
    except OSError as e:
        return False, f"#{capture_id}: extractor launch failed: {e}"

    out = ((result.stdout or "") + "\n" + (result.stderr or "")).strip()
    if result.returncode != 0:
        snip = out[-500:] if out else "(no output)"
        return False, f"#{capture_id}: extractor exit {result.returncode}: {snip}"

    mark_capture_promoted(db_path, capture_id, dest_path)
    _log(f"#{capture_id}: promoted → {dest_path}")
    if out:
        for line in out.splitlines()[-8:]:
            _log(f"  {line}")
    return True, dest_path

    def promote_captures(
    db_path: str,
    capture_ids: Sequence[int],
    promoted_folder: str,
    *,
    python_exe: Optional[str] = None,
    log: Optional[LogFn] = None,
) -> Tuple[int, int, List[str]]:
    """Promote many. Returns (ok_count, fail_count, messages)."""
    ok_n = 0
    fail_n = 0
    messages: List[str] = []
    for cid in capture_ids:
        ok, msg = promote_capture(
            db_path,
            int(cid),
            promoted_folder,
            python_exe=python_exe,
            log=log,
        )
        messages.append(msg)
        if ok:
            ok_n += 1
        else:
            fail_n += 1
            if log:
                log(msg)
    return ok_n, fail_n, messages

    def fetch_repo_to_capture(
    url_or_slug: str,
    capture_folder: str,
    *,
    method: str = "auto",  # auto | git | zip
    extensions: Optional[Sequence[str]] = None,
    timeout_sec: int = 120,
    log: Optional[LogFn] = None,
) -> List[str]:
    """Clone or zip-download repo; extract allowlisted files under captured_files/<owner>_<repo>/."""
    _log = log or (lambda _m: None)
    parsed = parse_github_repo(url_or_slug)
    if not parsed:
        _log("Could not parse GitHub owner/repo from input.")
        return []
    owner, repo, ref = parsed
    exts = {
        e.lower() if str(e).startswith(".") else f".{str(e).lower()}"
        for e in (extensions or DEFAULT_EXTS)
    }
    dest_leaf = f"{owner}_{repo}"
    dest_root = os.path.join(capture_folder, dest_leaf)
    os.makedirs(capture_folder, exist_ok=True)

    use_git = method == "git" or (
        method == "auto" and shutil.which("git") is not None
    )
    if method == "zip":
        use_git = False

    if use_git:
        written = _fetch_via_git(owner, repo, ref, dest_root, exts, timeout_sec, _log)
        if written:
            return written
        _log("git clone failed or empty - trying zip...")

    return _fetch_via_zip(owner, repo, ref, dest_root, exts, timeout_sec, _log)

    def parse_github_repo(url_or_slug: str) -> Optional[Tuple[str, str, str]]:
    """Return (owner, repo, ref) or None. Default ref=main."""
    s = (url_or_slug or "").strip().rstrip("/")
    if not s:
        return None
    # owner/repo[@ref]
    m = re.match(r"^([^/\s]+)/([^/\s@#]+)(?:@([^/\s]+))?$", s)
    if m and "github.com" not in s:
        return m.group(1), m.group(2).removesuffix(".git"), m.group(3) or "main"

    if not s.startswith(("http://", "https://")):
        s = "https://" + s
    try:
        p = urlparse(s)
    except Exception:
        return None
    if "github.com" not in (p.netloc or "").lower():
        return None
    parts = [x for x in p.path.split("/") if x]
    if len(parts) < 2:
        return None
    owner, repo = parts[0], parts[1].removesuffix(".git")
    ref = "main"
    if len(parts) >= 4 and parts[2] in ("tree", "blob"):
        ref = parts[3]
    return owner, repo, ref
